red_team_amendments.question: How often does my own attack change my draft, and which attack lands?
red_team_amendments.note: An attack dimension that has never amended anything is either unnecessary or being performed rather than run, and naming which is part of the report. After run 1: PRICED_IN_CHECK, ENTRY_BASIS_STRESS, CAPTURE_REALITY and PRE_MORTEM have each landed once. CROWDEDNESS_REALITY has landed zero times and I do not yet call it performative: on this name it was checked by tracing every level back to its input and it correctly found that nothing rested on the DARK score. A confirmation is an outcome. Re-examine it if it has confirmed three dives in a row without once changing a word.
red_team_amendments.recomputed_from: data/stocks/*.json: 1 dive(s) attacked, 1 amended. First red team in this repo's life, and it overturned the verdict it attacked (VRT TOO_LATE to WATCH). One run is not a rate: with a denominator of 1 this channel says the attack is capable of landing, and nothing about how often it will.

implied_growth.question: The market-implied CAGR I recorded at dive time, against what was actually delivered by review_by.
implied_growth.note: This grades the reverse DCF itself. Without it the gap table is a format, not a method. Run 1 already produced the finding this channel exists for: the implied column is one point on a surface that runs 14.62% to 37.52% across defensible assumption sets on the same price, and the explicit-period length is the choice that moves it most.

open_records.resolves_against: FY2026 reported net sales against the $13,800M-$14,200M guide, and the deferred-revenue balance against $3,633.7M at 2026-06-30. The five-year CAGR itself cannot resolve before 2030; the review date grades the first year of the path, not the path.
open_records.my_fcf_cagr_note: 17.1% stands as the defended path. The red team did not change it; it changed what the market column means. On the data plane's five-year explicit period the market column is 32.95%; on a ten-year period, same base and same discount and terminal rates, it is 18.33%. When this record resolves, grade the reverse DCF against BOTH readings or the channel will teach the wrong lesson.
